newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearbys hit by trade sales.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearbys hit by trade sales.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed Wednesday, with nearby contracts under pressure from a wave of heavy commercial selling near the close, KCBT floor traders said.
"The market held together pretty well through the day, but we just saw really good MOC (market on close) selling near the close and at the close," one floor trader said.

Despite the market's late slip toward session lows, spillover strength from CBOT soybean futures and good commercial buying early kept hard red winter wheat futures firm for most of the session, floor sources said.
Traders also said some of the market's late weakness was tied to CBOT soybean/KCBT wheat spread activity.
Firm cash basis levels as well as the continued lack of producer selling in cash markets helped to keep futures underpinned, traders said.
December wheat settled steady at $4.27-1/4 a bushel, with other contract months closing down 1/4 cent to up 2-1/2 cents.
